title: Broadside
tagline: Command a wooden warship in the age of sail.
teaser: Choose one of history’s sea fights, take a ship and give your orders: trim the sails, load round or grape, and wait for the moment to rake. Every sea, sky, ship and flag is drawn by code, and the rules are the 1980 game’s own.

manPage.synopsis: sail — steer by the wind, load your guns, win the engagement.
manPage.description: Dave Riggle wrote the first version on a PDP-11/70 in 1980, with Ed Wang as co-author and Craig Leres refitting it later. Its scenarios are drawn from real engagements.

howToPlay: Choose a battle and a ship, then load your guns.
Type or click your orders, then “Make it so” to play the turn.
Fire when you can rake; close in to board, or outsail them.
